structured_summary: In a quiet office environment, a robot delivers a package to a user. The robot must announce the delivery via speech. The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (via speech or head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement. Upon receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.
